preheader: Elon Musk hits trillionaire status again, Bitcoin holds near $85K, and Daniil Medvedev faces disqualification.

lead.headline: Elon Musk Is a Trillionaire Again as SpaceX and Tesla Rally
lead.body: Elon Musk's net worth has jumped by $65 billion, pushing him back past the trillion-dollar mark to $1.04 trillion. The surge is driven by rising valuations for his stakes in SpaceX and Tesla, with SpaceX shares up 13 percent since the start of the year.
lead.why: Understanding how concentrated equity stakes drive massive wealth fluctuations is critical for your finance classes and startup investing mindset.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Trades Near $85,000 as Investors Weigh Yields
stories.body: Bitcoin is trading in the $85,000 to $86,000 range as investors balance rising US Treasury yields against expectations of a less hawkish Federal Reserve.
stories.why: Cryptocurrency valuations react directly to macroeconomic shifts like interest rate expectations, giving you a real-world look at asset pricing.

stories.headline: Oprah-Backed True Food Kitchen Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
stories.body: Healthy eating restaurant chain True Food Kitchen has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection and closed 12 locations following management turmoil and failed expansion bets.
stories.why: Analyzing why high-profile restaurant expansions fail gives you a practical case study for your business strategy and consulting coursework.

stories.headline: OpenAI Implements Invisible Text Watermarks for EU Users
stories.body: OpenAI is rolling out an invisible, machine-readable text watermarking technology called textGrain to comply with the European Union's AI Act requirements.
stories.why: Regulatory compliance and data governance shape how tech companies build and deploy products globally, which matters for tech consulting.

stories.headline: Nvidia-Backed Reflection AI Unveils Open-Weight Model Beam
stories.body: Reflection AI, a startup founded by former Google DeepMind researchers, has introduced a cheaper, open-weight AI model named Beam to compete with US and China leaders.
stories.why: Open-weight models are shifting the enterprise software market, creating new opportunities for startups building vertical tools.

stories.headline: US Labour Market Splits into a Two-Tier Economy
stories.body: Business columnist Rana Aylin Foroohar warns that the US labor market is splitting into a two-tier structure where older workers keep secure jobs while younger workers struggle to find entry-level positions.
stories.why: As a first-year student, understanding these hiring friction points will help you target the right internships and networking strategies early.

stories.headline: Deloitte Highlights Shift in India's Infrastructure Challenges
stories.body: A Deloitte report indicates that India's infrastructure sector must focus on making projects investable and execution-ready rather than just raising capital.
stories.why: This highlights the exact kind of project preparation and risk analysis that consultants are hired to solve.

stories.headline: UC Irvine Student Found Dead on Campus
stories.body: Authorities are investigating the death of an 18-year-old UC Irvine student whose body was found on campus, with no foul play suspected.

term.name: Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
term.definition: A legal process that allows a financially distressed company to reorganize its debts and keep operating under court supervision while it tries to fix its business model. True Food Kitchen's recent filing shows how rapidly management turmoil and overexpansion can force a company into this restructuring phase.

serve.headline: Ghost AI raised $11 million to build personal AI agent hardware
serve.body: The 19-year-old founder secured the funding round led by Silicon Valley investors to build a dedicated personal computer running AI agents.
